cues: Read your table of derivatives backwards and you have a table of integrals.
Raise the power by one and divide by the new power, except for one over x, which gives log x. e to the x is its own integral.
Sine integrates to minus cosine, cosine to sine.
And the inverse trig derivatives give inverse trig integrals.
